memory_candidates.content: When appending a cross-reference sentence to the end of an existing paragraph in a markdown pattern file where a plan or lint requires 'zero removed lines' in the diff, add the new text as new trailing line(s) after the paragraph's existing final line rather than concatenating onto that line's text. Concatenating causes git to represent the existing line as replaced (one '-' plus one '+'), failing a strict addition-only verification even though no prior content was semantically changed.

A test suite explicitly marked by the test runner as 'load-sensitive: serialized, not in the parallel pool' (e.g. test-lake-build-guard.sh in this repo's run-all.sh) can report a spurious failure when bundled into a single --only invocation alongside other suites that run concurrently, even though the suite is unrelated to the files under test. Before attributing such a failure to one's own edit, re-run the flagged suite alone via --only <suite> to rule out transient resource contention under concurrent load.
